name: Chat History Persisted
description: Build a persisted chat history handle that stores conversation history in file or database storage.

controllers.name: history
controllers.description: Controller handle consumed by LLM nodes to load and append chat history.

parameters.name: max_messages
parameters.description: Maximum number of history messages to keep per session.

parameters.name: separator
parameters.description: Separator used when formatting history into prompt text.

parameters.name: keep_prompt_type
parameters.description: When enabled, prefixes each history line with system/user/assistant role.

parameters.name: storage_backend
parameters.description: Persistence backend used for chat history storage.
